messages:
Elena F.: FYI Synthora (acct SY-882) invoice INV-2026-0112 is 52 days overdue. Original $22,400, they applied $2k on 2026-03-20, outstanding $20,400. Dunning #4 sent this morning, no reply.

Tom S.: Yikes. Any active SRE or support incidents tied to them?

Priya (Billing): No open tickets. Usage looks clean: monthly plan $18k + overage $4,400 = $22,400. Partial payment posted. Bank returned no errors.

Raj (AM): Contacted CFO Marco earlier; says payroll hit them and asks for short extension or split into 2 payments over 30 days. Requests waive of return fees.

Elena F.: Our policy: need 25% upfront for split plans and we don't waive return/late fees without manager OK. Can finance accept 30/70 with proof of payment initiation for the first tranche within 5 business days? That makes first $6,120 then $14,280.

Tom S.: 30/70 acceptable. If they sign and show wire ref in 5 business days, pause suspension. Otherwise proceed with escalation.

Priya (Billing): If approved, I'll mark invoice as "payment-plan-proposed" and schedule reminders. Also turn off auto-suspend until first payment clears.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Sent dunning #4 to accounting@synthora.ai (2026-04-14T08:03:21Z). Delivered.

Raj (AM): I'll send the agreement now with the wire-proof clause and ask for a PO number. Will cc legal@redwood.

Elena F.: Good. Tagging this for check on 2026-04-22. If no signed plan + wire ref by then, escalate to legal and prepare suspension notice.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-22T09:00:00Z.
